data.narrative:
Lila Sciences is a Series A-stage biotech company founded by Geoffrey von Maltzahn and Molly Gibson that has raised $200M to date. The valuation analysis draws from a universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, Recursion Pharmaceuticals, and Freenome.

Of three valuation approaches tested, only Stage-Progression proved applicable. This method applies a 2.0x step-up multiplier typical of Series A advancement to the $200M total raised proxy, yielding an implied valuation of $400M. The Peer-Median approach could not be applied due to insufficient narrow peer coverage within same-stage and adjacent-stage filters (fewer than 3 datapoints). Public-Comp Anchoring was not feasible because Lila Sciences does not disclose revenue; while the Biotech & Health public median trades at 6.6x EV/Sales across 3 tickers, this multiple cannot be applied without revenue visibility.

The analysis supports a valuation range of $340M to $460M, with a median point of $400M. This range reflects high uncertainty around applicability of stage-based comparables to a frontier-tech platform in early commercialization. Key unknowns include actual revenue run-rate, cash burn trajectory, and the validity of generic stage multiples for the company's specific technology and market. A more definitive valuation would require either revenue disclosure or a denser private peer set at equivalent stages.
